$comment: Non-secret per-environment deploy config. Read by scripts/with-deploy-creds.ps1 to construct DATABASE_URL + DIRECT_URL at runtime from a password retrieved from PowerShell SecretStore. The actual password is never in this file or in any tracked file. The project_ref portion of `user` is half-credential at most (it's in public URLs anyway); committing it is acceptable for a private repo.

prod.$comment: PLACEHOLDER — prod Supabase project not yet provisioned. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PROD_PROJECT_REF in `user` once the prod DB is provisioned via an operator-approved path (the literal third active Free project in a separate org is blocked by the account-global 2-active-Free cap; use Supabase Pro without PITR ~$25/mo, a paused-non-prod $0 posture, or an ASK-FIRST $0 non-Supabase host — see docs/runbooks/launch-mvp.md §2). PITR is operator-waived (not an ADR-018 req). scripts/with-deploy-creds.ps1 rejects this placeholder string explicitly (line 75-77) so any accidental `pnpm db:*:prod` invocation fails fast. After replacement, populate the secret via `./scripts/store-deploy-password.ps1 prod`.
